speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Unjust steward. Goods. Friends of his master's goods. The heads are gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The unjust steward made friends of his master's goods. No. That is more than stayed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Goods not yet in his hand. That is the shard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shoes, the small debts, a horse at Lent. Twenty pounds, not mine, not yet had. I counted those, and I lost him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Attend properly next Sunday. Sit. Hear the man. Do not spend the hour.
